# Best 65W GaN chargers for a laptop and phone

**My pick: Anker 735 Charger (Nano II 65W)**
- **Why:** It's a compact three-port GaN II charger (2 USB-C, 1 USB-A) that Laptopbee's testing rates as the best overall 65W multiport charger. Anker's spec page lists the 65W maximum for either USB-C port when only one device is plugged in.
- **Price:** $29.99 at Newegg, sold by the Anker Official Store, with a 30-day return window.
- **Buy:** [Anker 735 (Nano II 65W) at Newegg](https://www.newegg.com/p/359-00D8-002C3)
- **Specs:** [Anker's spec page](https://service.anker.com/product-description/a085g000004x2BVAAY)
- **Catch:** Power is shared across ports. Laptop plus phone gives you about 45W + 20W. With all three ports in use, the top USB-C port drops to 40W and the others to 12W each. That's fine for a MacBook Air or XPS 13, but it won't run a 65W-hungry laptop at full speed.

## Other good options

- **Baseus Enercore 67W (CJ11), about $29.99:** Tom's Hardware named it the best 65W-range charger. It held full wattage through testing and ran the coolest of the group. It also has a built-in retractable USB-C cable and two more USB-C ports, so it's a good choice if you don't want to carry a separate cable. Tom's Hardware doesn't give a direct buy link in what I have, so check the [Tom's Hardware roundup](https://www.tomshardware.com/peripherals/usb/best-usb-chargers) for current Amazon and Best Buy links.
- **UGREEN Nexode Pro 65W:** Smart Gadget Kit picked it as the best overall for travel. It's a 113g body with three ports, a verified 65W from one port, and US, UK and EU plug heads in the box. The same 45W + 20W split applies when two devices are connected. [Smart Gadget Kit review](https://smartgadgetkit.com/best-gan-charger/) (it links to current prices).
- **Baseus GaN5 Pro 65W, $49.99 for a 2-pack:** This one supports PPS, so it can fast-charge Samsung Galaxy phones, and the 2-pack gives you one for home and one for your bag. The laptop port drops to 45W when you use a second device. [Product page](https://dealectric.com/baseus-gan5-pro-65w-2c-u). That site earns an affiliate commission on purchases through its links.

## Quick guidance
- **Samsung phone:** Choose a PPS charger like the Baseus GaN5 Pro. Laptopbee notes the standard Anker and UGREEN models lack PPS for Samsung Super Fast Charging 2.0. Anker's own spec page does list PPS for the 735, so confirm before buying if that matters to you.
- **Chargers don't include a cable.** Budget for a USB-C cable rated at 60W or more.
- **Larger laptops:** If you have a 14" or 16" MacBook Pro or a gaming laptop, 65W will only hold your charge under load. Consider a 100W charger instead.

Reviewers disagree on the Anker's exact per-port splits, so I used Anker's published numbers above.
